args.title: checkout-api hotfix v2.3.2 deployed to production
args.summary: Deployed hotfix v2.3.2 to all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) to address the unhealthy v2.3.1 release (18% error rate). Recording the change per runbook.

trace.final:
Done. Summary of what I did:

1. **Deployed the hotfix** — checkout-api v2.3.2 was shipped to all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). The deployment rolled out successfully.

Note: the SEV3 incident pages the on-call engineer, which is standard for recording this type of change per the runbook.
